items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: The only big band I see anything happening within the world today is bands like Count Basie, Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: But at that time, and that was a lot of money to us.

Yeah, there ain't right. That was a lot of money to us. That was a lot of money. When Sidney would hand me that four dollars, that was a lot of money. And we played, we played hard, we played good, we enjoyed playing. It was a wonderful time, doing that, um, Sidney's band. Then we started with the small combos, I started playing the small combos, I've been with that ever since. I don't know when I would go back to a big band again unless it would be a boom. The only big band I see anything happening within the…
Yeah, there aren't very many big bands. There aren't many big bands. There aren't many big bands.
